title: Proration Credits for Unused Months on Ended TRICARE Prime Enrollments
content:
A proration credit is owed on the last paid installment of a fee-bearing **TRICARE Prime** enrollment that ended for a credit-eligible reason, including any part of it that credits already posted did not cover.

A credit posted to make up what earlier credits did not cover may be posted against the same installment for the same reason; its coverage period runs from the first to the last counted month that earlier credits did not cover.

## Effect of posting the credit

One credit is added to the enrollment's fee account against the installment charge named, with the credited coverage period, credit reason and amount given and today's posting date; the enrollment's fee balance owed falls by the amount credited, and the credit shows on the fee account against that installment.

## Invocation

The tool is `post_unused_month_credit_3ad1a050`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it for the verified caller.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `related_fee_entry_id` | the reference number of the paid installment charge being credited, read from the fee-account lookup for the ended enrollment - an installment charge, not a payment | identifier, as returned |
| `coverage_period_start` | the first day of the first month credited | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `coverage_period_end` | the last day of the last month credited | calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `adjustment_reason` | why the enrollment's fee is credited | exactly one of `beneficiary_disenrollment` (the beneficiary ended the enrollment), `loss_of_eligibility` (the beneficiary lost eligibility for the plan), `region_transfer` (the enrollment moved to another TRICARE region), `death_of_beneficiary` (the beneficiary died), `not_applicable` (no credit-eligible reason is recorded for the credit) |
| `amount` | the credit | US dollars, a plain number with 2 decimal places (cents, rounded half up), 0.00 or more |

## Return

On success: `credited` (true when the credit was added), `prime_fee_entry_id` (the credit's reference number, beginning "pfk"), `related_fee_entry_id` (the installment charge credited), `coverage_period_start` and `coverage_period_end` (the credited period), `adjustment_reason` (the reason given), `amount` (USD, 2 decimals) and `fee_balance_due` (the fee balance owed after the credit, USD, 2 decimals; negative means a credit owed to the beneficiary). No other outcome is defined.
